messages:
mika: CI publish job failed on release pipeline, semver-guard blocked. regen diff looks like only changelog entry order changed, no code delta. anyone seen this before?
sam: can you paste the CI link/output?
mika: https://ci.redwood/reports/175890 — error snippet below:
```
error: semver-check failed: detected no meaningful API delta but changelog contains re-ordered entries -> aborting publish (exit 1)
regen-diff summary:
  M changelogs/2026-03-22-sdk.md
  - Authentication
  + API: rate-limits
  (only ordering changed)
```
ci-bot: :warning: publish-checker v2.1.0 failed: changelog-order must be deterministic. See https://docs.redwood/regen#changelog-sort
jon: ran `yarn regen` locally, same reorder. interestingly typegen hash stayed the same. might be a nondeterministic sort in the changelog generator (node locale or object iteration). my env: macOS 13, node 18.16
anya: recent OpenAPI cleanups re-ordered some paths. the changelog generator iterates object keys for sections. we should stable-sort keys by path before rendering. quick local fix: `yarn regen --stable-sort` seemed to keep order consistent for me.
devon: opened PR 3421 that adds a deterministic sort and a small semver heuristic tweak (compare endpoint signatures). PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/3421. also added a test that replays the failing spec.
sam: we shouldn't loosen semver-guard, but we do need to avoid churn where only ordering changed. could we accept regen-only commits if the typehash is identical?
anya: we can add an allowlist flag e.g. `--allow-regen-if-typehash-unchanged` and gate it behind CI approval. patch in PR 3421 includes `--stable-sort` + docs.
mika: another related issue: onboarding sampleapp broke because SDK auth API changed in v1.4.0 — `auth.getToken()` now throws instead of returning null, so sampleapp init fails during onboarding tests. repro:
```js
// sampleapp boot
const token = await client.auth.getToken();
// now throws: TypeError: getToken is not a function or throws Error('no credentials')
```
sam: ah, this release includes auth/retry refactor. we should add a compatibility shim or bump sampleapp before publish. we can't publish SDK without breaking onboarding docs.
devon: PR 3422 adds shim: `auth.getToken()` returns null + deprecation warning for one release. will add changelog note.
jon: plan: 1) land PR 3421 (stable sort) + regen commit 2) land PR 3422 (auth shim) 3) run full regen + publish dry-run 4) if typehash unchanged, allow CI to skip changelog-block for this specific release via a manual override step tracked in release notes.
ci-bot: rerun requested jobs queued: publish-checker, regen-check, unit-tests.
anya: I'll update the release docs with the `--stable-sort` recommendation and note about `--allow-regen-if-typehash-unchanged`. also will add a section about how auth API changes require sampleapp bump.
mika: going to notify support for customers hit by the blocked publish. temporary workaround: publish a dist tarball and attach to customer support case. thanks all. :party_parrot:
jon: landing PRs now, will ping when CI is green. :thumbsup:
